text:
Alice - New Hire: Hi folks, unpacked my Mac and during Setup Assistant I clicked through but now System Settings shows 'MDM enrollment: pending' and FileVault toggle is greyed out. Docker install fails because I don't have sudo. Morning of day 1 :sweat_smile: Any quick fixes?
Ben (IT): Welcome Alice! First, do you remember if you signed in with Okta during setup? If not, DEP flow can skip.
Alice - New Hire: I did sign in with Okta. It shows the company account.
Onboard Bot: Ticket ONB-3210 created. ETA 2 hours.
Sam - EngInfra: Can you paste your serial and run `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status`? Also `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` (might prompt).
Alice - New Hire: Serial is H0L1C3N0TE5
Alice - New Hire: `profiles: No enrolled profiles`
Alice - New Hire: `fdesetup: FileVault is Off`
Sam - EngInfra: Hmm. Try `sudo log show --predicate 'process == "mdmclient"' --last 5m | tail -n 40` and paste any mdmclient errors.
Alice - New Hire: pasted: "mdmclient: failed to fetch configuration: 403 device not found"
Sam - EngInfra: 403 usually means the serial isn't linked in DEP or Jamf needs a re-sync. Opening a Jamf re-enroll for H0L1C3N0TE5 now.
Tess (People Ops): I can approve temporary admin while eng-infra works the Jamf side. Alice, who's your manager for approval?
Alice - New Hire: Manager is Ben.
Ben (IT): I approve temporary admin for Alice for 6 hours during onboarding. Tess, please provision.
Tess (People Ops): Done 1: temp admin created for alice@redwood.com, expires in 6 hours. You should see admin in System Settings -> Users & Groups after a logout/login.
Alice - New Hire: I see the admin flag now. Able to `sudo` and installed Docker via Homebrew. Thanks.
Sam - EngInfra: Jamf re-enroll pushed and APNS re-sync requested. Reboot when convenient and accept any "Remote Management" prompt. I'll monitor logs.
Sam - EngInfra: Follow-up: re-enroll succeeded, profile applied, pushing FileVault enable profile.
Onboard Bot: ONB-3210 updated: MDM profile applied, FileVault profile queued, temporary admin scheduled for auto-revoke in 6 hours.
Alice - New Hire: Restarted, accepted Remote Management. FileVault shows "Enabling" after restart. Everything else working.
Tess (People Ops): Temporary admin will be revoked as soon as FileVault shows enabled. Welcome aboard Alice!
Alice - New Hire: All green 1 FileVault enabled and Docker + dev tools installed. Huge thanks everyone! :tada:
